name: mabosstiff
flavor: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

abilities.name: intimidate
abilities.effect: Lowers opponents' Attack one stage upon entering battle.

abilities.name: guard-dog
abilities.effect: Boosts Attack if intimidated, and prevents being forced to switch out.

abilities.name: stakeout
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's moves have double power against Pokémon that switched in this turn.
